summary: Measured GPU cost of each graphics setting, from the new --gpu-bench mode.
rationale: A performance change is shown by measured numbers with their conditions: two runs on one card and resolution, each setting switched off and on ten times, with render scale as the control. No image would prove a cost.

capture.machine: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090, Forward+ (Vulkan), 1920x1080 off-screen window
capture.command: --offscreen --nohud --perf=0 --scenario=roster --seed=3 --mood=golden --preset=cinematic --focus=-84,24 --zoom=34 --gpu-bench=costs.json --gpu-bench-at=10 (second run with --gpu-bench-only for the Cinematic and noisy settings)
capture.control: render scale 100% vs 50%: +7.40 ms (spread 0.76) and +6.86 ms (spread 0.63)
capture.caveat: Other programs drawing on the same card widen the spread; settings marked too small to measure stayed within about half a millisecond in both runs.
